ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Combinational Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Combinational Logic Circuits.

3. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

4. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

6. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.

7. When learning Project Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project Implementation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Implementation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Implementation.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. When learning Single phase Alternating Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

10. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

11. When learning Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.

12. When learning Direct Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Direct Current Motors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Direct Current Motors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Direct Current Motors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Direct Current Motors.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drafting and Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fabrication Techniques and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
